text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I find myself thinking that perhaps this was for the best.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: What do you mean 'good thing'...? You mean that we lost?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Had I won, I might have thought,
"Is that all there is to it?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: No matter how much effort I put in, no matter how much wind I whipped up, I couldn't reach it.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Is that not the greatest proof of all
that what we challenged was truly a tempest?"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"And that hardship...
will elevate us to even greater heights.
It will evolve us into an even swifter wind."

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Losing is so uncool.
...And it hurts so, so much.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Even so, we can still run. As long as we can still run... we won't give up!"

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
One day, I shall become the ideal wind."
